cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Agree to the Exact Words
cards.instruction: Agree to the exact wording, then use later callbacks to narrow what those words can obligate you to do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, I'll carry one box. Mark the chosen one clearly before I lift anything, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said you'd help me move. There's a whole room here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: By carrying one box. Please don't count the room as a container; choose the box covered by the offer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then take the biggest. It's full of books.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tape the base first. I'll carry that one, then I'm finished; helping with the room was the one box, not everything left after it.

reason: Remove an invented stack proposal; accept B's largest-box choice with proper handling and a direct callback to the earlier room-wide claim.
